text: A plan must be established for continuing activities when systems supporting OM are unavailable.
Systems supporting OM should be capable of using configurable, domain-specific vocabulary.
A Subject ID should also be collected for animals in an OM investigation.
Information about each leg of a trip, as well as the parent information about the trip, should be captured.
Systems supporting OM must allow for dynamic, event-specific case investigation data to be captured.
Systems supporting OM must provide the ability to control the configuration of and revisions to investigation-specific questionnaires.
Entity-to-epi data links must match the entity to their symptoms, survey questions, specimens/samples collected, laboratory results, and prophylaxis and treatment data.
Systems supporting OM must support contact exposure tracing by allowing one contact to be linked to multiple cases, and allowing multiple contacts to be linked to a single case.
